name: googletest
description: GoogleTest - Google Testing and Mocking Framework
one_liner: Google's free, standard toolkit for writing automated tests for C++ programs.
buyer: Not directly sellable — it's foundational open-source infrastructure that C++ teams use for free.
business_use_cases: A software consultancy uses it as the standard test framework when writing C++ code for clients, billing for the testing work itself.
An embedded-systems company builds its safety-critical test suite on top of it.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid 'test suite setup and coverage' consulting for C++ teams that have no tests yet, using this as the framework.

steal_this: Not really a product to build — it's a foundation. If anything, offer a paid 'add tests to your untested C++ codebase' service using it.
